PRESCHOOL BABY DEATHS

By: Tarryn Crossman | Production

Proposal


Show:

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
two infants at the same unregistered nursery school went down for their afternoon nap and never woke we investigate up

Summary:
two babies die on the same day in an unregistered nursery school in the Eastern Cape, the principle has fled the country and the only person left who was taking care of them on the day they passed has made various claims of medicating the children to Private investigator Samanatha K.


Further information:
How did two infants die at the same unregistered nursery school, on the same day without any explanation?
We follow private investigator Samanatha K as she tried to unravel the mysterious of their death

Ezam Makhabane's was 5 months old, according to her mom when she dropped her at day care on the morning of the 31st of August she was happy and not sick at all. She has a home video of that morning that she shared with me
Kwahlelwa Ndongeni's granny says the same of her 6 month old grandson.


Regardless that afternoon both families received a call from frere hospital that no parent ever wants to receive, their babies were declared dead on arrival.

What had taken place in that nursery school between 6am and 3pm that afternoon?

Samantha K is a private investigator that read about the story in the news and decided to track down the parents and offer her services for free

Her first point of call was the investigating officer, Mrs Gengqeza, Who over the phone openly admitted that even though it has been a month, since the infants passed, she has done nothing on the case. Not even a single interview. When asked where the principle of the school was, she responded that the principle was not a suspect, but that they believe she had fled to Zimbabwe after pressure from the community.
She then lied that the toxicology report was being done in CT. Sam then went to the frere and the specimens for the toxicology where still there and had in fact never been sent to CT.

Sam then went to Southernwood to try and track down some of the staff that were working at the school on the day in question. Escorted by the community policing forum she went from house to house until she tracked down Malindi, One of two woman who were taking care of the babies at the school. she claimed that the school had
30 babies in one classroom and then 30 toddlers in another classroom and a further 30 older kids in the lounge, with a total of 4 care takers present.

She claims that both children came with medication for teething which she used a Tspoon to administer throughout the day. Both parents deny this. She also claims that they administered medication like Calpol, allergex and panado to the children without their parents consent or without any formal medical report


According DSD the school is not registered and was given a order to shutdown months before this incident.

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): two infants at the same unregistered nursery school went down for their afternoon nap and never woke we investigate up
metadata.Summary: two babies die on the same day in an unregistered nursery school in the Eastern Cape, the principle has fled the country and the only person left who was taking care of them on the day they passed has made various claims of medicating the children to Private investigator Samanatha K.
metadata.Further information: How did two infants die at the same unregistered nursery school, on the same day without any explanation? We follow private investigator Samanatha K as she tried to unravel the mysterious of their death Ezam Makhabane's was 5 months old, according to her mom when she dropped her at day care on the morning of the 31st of August she was happy and not sick at all. She has a home video of that morning that she shared with me Kwahlelwa Ndongeni's granny says the same of her 6 month old grandson. Regardless that afternoon both families received a call from frere hospital that no parent ever wants to receive, their babies were declared dead on arrival. What had taken place in that nursery school between 6am and 3pm that afternoon? Samantha K is a private investigator that read about the story in the news and decided to track down the parents and offer her services for free Her first point of call was the investigating officer, Mrs Gengqeza, Who over the phone openly admitted that even though it has been a month, since the infants passed, she has done nothing on the case. Not even a single interview. When asked where the principle of the school was, she responded that the principle was not a suspect, but that they believe she had fled to Zimbabwe after pressure from the community. She then lied that the toxicology report was being done in CT. Sam then went to the frere and the specimens for the toxicology where still there and had in fact never been sent to CT. Sam then went to Southernwood to try and track down some of the staff that were working at the school on the day in question. Escorted by the community policing forum she went from house to house until she tracked down Malindi, One of two woman who were taking care of the babies at the school. she claimed that the school had 30 babies in one classroom and then 30 toddlers in another classroom and a further 30 older kids in the lounge, with a total of 4 care takers present. She claims that both children came with medication for teething which she used a Tspoon to administer throughout the day. Both parents deny this. She also claims that they administered medication like Calpol, allergex and panado to the children without their parents consent or without any formal medical report According DSD the school is not registered and was given a order to shutdown months before this incident.
